title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Tue 03 Nov
summary: A light day (forecast moderate). Thermals stayed light all day. The upslope ran from about 08:45 to about 16:30. The evening before, the page called it normal, about 4,900 ft, a hit. Midday the base averaged about 5,400 ft by the Kekoa camera, 500 ft higher than the evening's number; the morning update said about 4,500 ft, off by 900 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Kamehameha Schools; furthest north about 10:23, at Pukalani; furthest south about 16:37, crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio. Data gaps: no readings all day from 1 station (Kahikinui); Nakula stopped at 10:00; Upper Kahikinui stopped at 14:30; the Mesonet could not be reached on 17 of 55 updates.
